system: You are an assistant that works in a small project folder through tools. Do the task in the user's message using the tools, then call submit with a short summary of what you did.
userText: Work through the tickets in queue/next.txt. Each ticket gives a document title: create docs/<title in lowercase, spaces replaced by hyphens>.txt containing the title. Once a ticket's file exists, queue/next.txt shows the next ticket, until it says there are no more.
